title: RNADaemon: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Molecular Dynamics for RNA Tertiary Structure Prediction.
authors: Xu, Wentao; Wu, You; Yu, Xiang
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文将RNA三级结构预测建模为马尔可夫决策过程，用强化学习引导全原子分子动力学模拟，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其RL+MD框架可迁移至蛋白质构象采样与结构预测，具有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: Accurate prediction of RNA tertiary structure remains a central challenge in structural biology, yet existing computational approaches face fundamental limitations arising from the ruggedness of the RNA free-energy landscape and the scarcity of experimentally resolved structures. Here we present RNADaemon, a framework that formulates RNA tertiary structure prediction as a Markov Decision Process and trains a Soft Actor-Critic agent to apply adaptive external force-field biases that steer all-atom molecular dynamics toward native-like conformations to minimize the eRMSD metric. Trained on 479 monomeric RNA structures and evaluated on 14 test cases from CASP16, RNA-Puzzles, and the PDB, the agent trains stably, approaches SimRNA and FARFAR2 in median RMSD, and recovers the global fold of most reference structures. However, performance remains markedly inferior to that of AlphaFold 3 and trRosettaRNA. We identify the scalar Bellman error as a fundamental information bottleneck that currently limits the performance of the agent. To our knowledge, this is the first application of continuous-action deep reinforcement learning (RL) with all-atom force fields to RNA tertiary structure prediction. This study establishes a benchmark for future comparisons and provides diagnostic insights for RL-guided RNA structure modeling.
abstract_zh: RNA三级结构的准确预测仍是结构生物学中的核心挑战，然而现有计算方法因RNA自由能景观的崎岖性以及实验解析结构的稀缺性而面临根本性限制。在此，我们提出RNADaemon，一个将RNA三级结构预测表述为马尔可夫决策过程（Markov Decision Process）的框架，并训练一个Soft Actor-Critic智能体，以施加自适应外部力场偏置，引导全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 趋向天然样构象，从而最小化eRMSD指标。该智能体在479个单体RNA结构上训练，并在来自CASP16、RNA-Puzzles和PDB的14个测试案例上评估，训练稳定，在中位RMSD上接近SimRNA和FARFAR2，并恢复大多数参考结构的整体折叠。然而，其性能仍明显逊于AlphaFold 3和trRosettaRNA。我们识别出标量贝尔曼误差（Bellman error）作为当前限制智能体性能的基本信息瓶颈。据我们所知，这是连续动作深度强化学习 (deep reinforcement learning, RL) 与全原子力场在RNA三级结构预测中的首次应用。本研究为未来比较建立了基准，并为RL引导的RNA结构建模提供了诊断性见解。
